description: Ordered, idempotent migrations for keys in the user shell.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hornero/shell.json). Applied by `horneroctl update plan --apply` before the new shell reads the file, so a renamed key never drops its value. Every op is reported to the user; nothing is removed silently.

migrations.summary: Material-era theme ids and fonts map to their Hornero Signal equivalents.
The Gaming Focus toast switch moved from utilities to experience.
Settings with no Signal equivalent are retired; their old values stay in the update report and the pre-update backup.

ops.reason: Custom Bezier curves became named motion styles (smooth, lively, calm); pick one in Appearance > Look.
The old icon font is retired; Hornero Glyphs are built into the shell and need no font setting.
The clock uses the display typeface now; set it in Appearance > Fonts.
The launcher scheme picker was replaced by Chromatic themes.
The launcher variant picker was replaced by Chromatic themes.

migrations.summary: Appearance section disclosure got a new key so Themes opens by default on upgraded configs.

ops.reason: Which Appearance sections start open is remembered under a new key; the old list is not carried over on purpose so Themes opens again.

migrations.summary: The 'Config loaded' and 'Num lock' toasts fired on every boot; they are switched off once. Turn them back on in Notifications at any time.
